n: Πέτρον (Petron) 'Peter' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of Κηφᾶν (Kēphan) 'Cephas' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
ἦλθεν (ēlthen) 'he came' occurs in a few manuscripts (Treg) instead of ἦλθον, (ēlthon) 'they came,' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+TR+Byz)
τῇ ἀληθείᾳ μὴ πείθεσθαι, (tēa alētheia mē peithesthai) 'the truth not to obey' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
ἐν ὑμῖν (en humin) 'among you' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
ἄνθρωπος (anthrōpos) 'man' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
εἰς Χριστὸν (eis Christon) 'into Christ' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
ὑμῶν (humōn) 'of you' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of ἡμῶν (hēmōn) 'of us' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
Χριστοῦ.¶ (Christou) 'Christ.' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
μου (mou) 'of me' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of ὑμῶν (humōn) 'of you' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
Τίς (Tis) 'what' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of Ποῦ (Pou) 'Where' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg+KJV)
πάντων (pantōn) 'of all' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
ἡμεῖς (hēmeis) 'we ourselves' occurs in traditional manuscripts (WH+TR+Byz) instead of ὑμεῖς (humeis) 'you yourselves' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+Treg)
ἐσμέν (esmen) 'we are' occurs in traditional manuscripts (WH+TR+Byz) instead of ἐστέ. (este) 'you are.' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+Treg)
ἑαυτόν (he'auton) 'himself' occurs in a few manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of σεαυτόν. (seauton) 'yourself.' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg+KJV)
μοιχεία (moicheia) 'adultery' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
φόνοι, (phonoi) 'murders' is only in traditional manuscripts (Tyn+Treg+TR+Byz)
Ἰησοῦ (Iēsou) 'Jesus' is only in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+WH+Treg)
ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ (en Christō Iēsou) 'in Christ Jesus' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
ἰσχύει (ischuei) 'prevails' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of ἐστιν (estin) 'is' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
κυρίου (kuriou) 'Lord' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
πρός Γαλάτας ἐγράφη ἀπό Ῥώμης.¶ (pros Galatas egraphē apo Rhōmēs) 'to Galatians it was written from Rome.' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR)
